title: Business Logic, Concurrency, and Workflow Security
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Business Logic, Concurrency, and Workflow Security.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Business Logic, Concurrency, and Workflow Security topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
